name: @dynjandi/sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for Dynjandi, an image CDN.

scripts.check:generated: tmp=$(mktemp) && trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT && openapi-typescript ../spec/openapi.yaml -o "$tmp" > /dev/null && diff -u src/generated/api.d.ts "$tmp" || { echo 'src/generated/api.d.ts is out of date: run pnpm --filter @dynjandi/sdk run generate'; exit 1; }
